name: relay-bar
description: What the agents agent-relay dispatched are doing, in a band above the prompt and a /relay pane, read from the runs' own status files: no tool, no prompt, no tokens

visible.title: Show the band
visible.description: Show the band while relay runs work; /relay off and /relay on set this too

toast.title: Toast when a run ends
toast.description: A toast when a dispatched agent finishes, fails or asks a question

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band and the pane; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
